entities.summary: Dimitriana Bezede, known as Dimitriana Surdu until 2021, is a Moldovan athlete who specialises in the shot put. She competed for Moldova at the Summer Olympics in 2016, 2020 and 2024 and at the European Games in 2016 and 2023.
